description:
About the Scholarship

Massey's Alumni Doctoral Scholarship is a university award for eligible graduates pursuing doctoral research. The published NZD 90,000 value is a total across the award period, with fee support, rather than a stipend of NZD 90,000 each year.

Research Areas

  • Eligible Massey doctoral subjects
  • Research training
  • Doctoral study

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 90,000 total over three years, plus fees
DurationThree years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityEligible Massey alumni
Further conditionsMassey alumni; total award is not an annual cash stipend.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming: opens 1 November 2026
Deadline / consideration round1 February 2027
LocationNew Zealand

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.massey.ac.nz/study/scholarships-and-awards/massey-university-alumni-doctoral-scholarship/

Source: massey.ac.nz - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About Massey University

Massey offers doctoral research in science, food technology and other disciplines. Its scholarship portfolio includes alumni awards and subject-specific funding, with eligibility and application dates set out for each award.

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
